includeAnnouncementPost.description: Attach the full announcement post (text, author, metrics, media) to every article row.
includeAnnouncementPost.title: Include announcement post

includeArticleBody.description: Include the complete article text: bodyText, bodyMarkdown, the rich content blocks, inline media and links.
includeArticleBody.title: Include full article body

includeAuthorProfile.description: Enrich the author with their public profile (follower count, bio, verification, join date) so engagementRate can be computed.
includeAuthorProfile.title: Include full author profile

includeCoverImage.description: Include the article's cover image link.
includeCoverImage.title: Include cover image

includePreviewText.description: Include the short preview text X shows for the article.
includePreviewText.title: Include preview text

maxItems.description: Stop after this many article rows. Status rows are not counted.
maxItems.title: Maximum articles

tweetUrls.description: Paste the post that announces the article (the post whose card opens the article), or the article link itself. For example https://x.com/vxunderground/status/1979885711579865307.
tweetUrls.title: Article announcement posts or Article links
